svg.title: What each of the five buttons touches
svg.desc: A five by four grid. Rows are the five buttons, columns are start at login, variables, log, and locator / path record. A check means kept, a dash means removed, a dot means read only. The log cell of row 3 says ask: double-clicking that button stops to ask whether to keep the log, and Enter keeps it. Row 5 only reads while it checks; it acts only after you agree to update, and then it is a full install.
